en.added_plain_text: Which functions should a feature-wall brief identify first? Identify whether the wall is mainly decorative, for a television, display or storage, then list retained equipment, sockets and access needs. Supply dimensions and photos, separately flagging known dampness, damage or other site concerns for assessment. A rendering communicates visual direction; it does not confirm equipment installation, wall conditions or material performance. Connect the main work to the appropriate service scope For colour and texture, review artistic wall planning; for television units, display cabinetry and storage, see custom furniture. Confirm samples, edge details, equipment interfaces and quotation inclusions separately. These style ideas are not evidence of a current trend survey, available stock or completed client work.

zh.added_plain_text: 背景墙需求应先说明哪些功能？ 说明它主要用于装饰、电视、展示还是收纳，再列出拟保留设备、插座和需要取用或维护的位置。提供墙面尺寸与照片，并把已知潮湿、破损或其他现场问题单独标注给负责方评估。效果图用于沟通视觉方向，不证明具体设备安装、墙体条件或材料性能已经确认。 按主要工作连接合适的服务范围 以颜色和肌理为主时，可查看 艺术墙面规划；涉及电视柜、展示柜和收纳时，可查看 定制家具服务。样板、收边、设备接口和报价包含范围应分别确认。文章中的风格方向不代表当年市场趋势调查、可用库存或已经完成的客户案例。

review_scope: New incremental content and required preserved boundaries; existing published text remains verbatim as plain text prefix. No blanket certification of every pre-existing marketing statement.
review: Function/equipment/site concerns separated from renders; no current trend survey, stock or completed-client claim. Existing 2025 title is untouched.
limits: No Save/permit/frontend/business claim. If another same-row candidate saves first, exact full-row baseline invalidates this original target.
